description: Cancels a queued job, or stops the remaining parts of a sweep that spans several sheets. Returns the updated job. Do not use this to check status or to download results; call get_job for that. A bake that has already been dispatched cannot be cancelled.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by submit. This is not an idempotency_key.

name: cancel_job
title: Cancel a job
